source.content: A queue releases its **oldest** item first.

blocks.alt: Animation of items entering and leaving a FIFO queue
blocks.fallback: Items enter at the back and leave from the front, so the **oldest** item always leaves first, as [the introduction](#intro) says.
blocks.caption: Watch which item leaves first.

blocks.alt: Boxes in a row with an arrow at each end
blocks.fallback: Four boxes in a row. An arrow enters at the back and another leaves at the front.

blocks.alt: A spoken summary of how a queue works
blocks.fallback: A queue is first in, first out.
